approvalsDesc: Agents ask before a tool changes something outside JT-Code (posting, sending, writing). Editors and admins decide.
catalogDesc: What agents in this workspace may call. Tools that change something ask for approval first.
noTools: No tools are enabled for this workspace.
adminOnly: Connecting servers and storing credentials is for workspace admins.
serversDesc: Connect a Model Context Protocol server over HTTPS, list its tools, and choose which ones agents may use.
credentialsDesc: Tokens that tools use. They are stored encrypted and never shown again.
credentialName: Name (saved as letters, numbers and hyphens)
removeConfirm: Remove “{{name}}”? Agents can no longer use it.
